summary: Bind media recording to actual Playwright video output

delivery.outcome: Report recording only when a live Playwright page has video enabled, then save and verify its finalized WebM after the caller closes that page. Publish after required tests and independent review.
nonGoals: Do not create or close shared browser pages/contexts, enable video retroactively, alter noVNC setup or change dependencies.

architecture.decision: Bind the existing media executor to page.video. Refuse missing/unconfigured/closed pages at start, refuse finalization while the page is open, and use video.save_as before validating the real output through VideoRecorder. Preserve owned state on retryable save errors.
architecture.rollback: Protected revert of this implementation while preserving recorded artifacts.

commands: Real Playwright WebM test and ffprobe
Managed governance and required CI matrix
